purpose: Measure ordinary normal-form image rejection against its deterministic-selection parent with identical scalar capabilities.
prerequisites: Normal-image feasibility: ten commands, fourteen tests, strict scalar Clippy and all twelve native transcripts unchanged.
source_change: Two private scalar implementation files and two tests, exactly as frozen in sphere-normal-image-v1. The driver verifies both full snapshots and links their previously built scalar libraries.
phases: One first explicit query, then a fixed number of queries on the same prepared retained value. Constructors and shared constants may already have warmed caches; first query is not claimed to mean a wholly cold internal state.
modes: requested global allocator traffic and retained/peak byte deltas
mathematical_controls: Both groups use the image argument in the unchanged recipe semantics: rational and dyadic controls, both normal zero identities and the affine zero recipe are required. All other existing query outcomes must remain unchanged. Every definite result is checked against its exact oracle and replay may not weaken any known fact.
input_identity: Fixed Rust construction recipes; no float projection. Coarse structural kind metadata is emitted after query measurements and compared across groups; it is explicitly not claimed to be a dispatch trace.
timing_scope: Query-body wall time includes black-box barriers, exact-result assertions and monotonicity checks. First-query singleton timers and allocator-instrumented timers do not support performance claims.
screen_rule: For an equal-answer repeated phase, flag candidate/parent overhead only if all six paired ratios exceed 1.10, the median exceeds 1.15 and both median phase times are at least 2000000 ns. Publish all ratios and counters regardless of flag; no flag does not prove no regression.
retention_scope: Requested heap allocator traffic and live-byte deltas; not stack usage, usable allocator sizes, RSS or a universal memory bound.
frozen_sample_policy: No extension, filtering, replacement or pooling with other experiments. Preserve the original first failure if one occurs.
pending_after_trial: Original native sphere costs and resource effects if the scalar change remains viable.
Broader qualification, directed adversarial/representation campaign and production formal proof obligations.
Public resource documentation and admission record.
version_reason: A new code candidate compared against its own parent. Five fixed repetition counts are increased before execution because the earlier baseline comparison had short phases. No prior trial is extended, filtered or pooled.
affine_original_zero_recipe: The scalar cost recipe uses original 32x16 source indices [0,1,368,256] at unit radius. It is a finite scalar API cost case, not a replacement for any full-resolution native sphere input or a native hull performance gate.
